items.title: AI-enriched ingestion pipelines for searchable live and VOD media on AWS
items.summary: As organizations adopt TAMS and cloud-centered workflows through the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud-Native Agile Production (CNAP) program, the opportunity is clear: Make content discoverable by what it contains rather than how it was tagged. This post, which is Part 1 of a two-part series, describes how AI-powered ingestion pipelines analyze each piece of media at ingest time.
items.creator: Mohan Kumar Guruswamy
